subject.title: vllm openai-completions streaming parser drops tool_calls when reasoning_content streams first for gpt-oss-120b at large systemPrompt

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrowly evidenced structured-stream fix only, or should it also add recovery that turns persisted assistant text back into executable tool calls?
rationale: The exact failure is unproven on current main, and the suggested post-processing path changes the boundary between model text and executable tool actions.

options.title: Require a structured-stream repro first
options.body: Capture the current vLLM SSE sequence and fix only the parser path that loses authenticated native `delta.tool_calls`.

options.title: Permit text recovery
options.body: Adopt text-to-tool reclassification only with an explicit maintainer-approved security contract and proof that it cannot execute ordinary assistant text.

recommendation.title: Require a structured-stream repro first
recommendation.body: Capture the current vLLM SSE sequence and fix only the parser path that loses authenticated native `delta.tool_calls`.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history connects steipete to the adjacent OpenAI streaming tool-call area and the security-sensitive boundary decision.
